events.title: Himeji Castle (White Heron)
events.description: UNESCO-listed and Japan’s best-preserved feudal castle—brilliant white plaster walls and massive keeps.

events.title: Kōko-en Garden
events.description: Nine Edo-style strolling gardens beside the castle—tea houses, ponds and quiet paths.

events.title: Mt. Shosha & Engyō-ji
events.description: Forest-clad temple complex atop Mount Shosha—ropeway access and a famed film location.
